newsitem.title: GHANA: Social Sec Bank trade dominates dull Ghana bourse.
newsitem.headline: Social Sec Bank trade dominates dull Ghana bourse.

text.p: The Ghana Stock Exchange edged higher on Monday but volume was low, except for another large transaction in the shares of Social Security Bank (SSB).
The All-Share index rose 0.46 point to 385.59.

The price of SSB shares was unchanged at 1,350 cedis, but 3,776,500 changed hands, adding to the 1,022,100 traded on Friday -- almost seven percent of the issued share capital in total, a stake worth some 6.5 billion cedis ($3 million), according to bourse data.

Dealers said it appeared the government was in the process of transferring its stake in the bank to Social Security National Insurance Trust (SSNIT), another state body, although nothing official had yet been announced.
They said the government was planning to issue a statement on the transfer later in the week. SSB has several non-governmental institutional shareholders, dealers said.
SSB accounted for almost all the 3,875,900 sharres traded on Monday.
The only shares to rise in price were those of Accra Brewery Ltd, up 30 to 650 cedis, and Enterprise Insurance Company, up five cedis to 530.
Mobil Oil Ghana was the sole loser, down 60 to 6,500. ($ = 2100 cedis)
